newsitem.title: USA: White House declines comment on Lott tax remarks.
newsitem.headline: White House declines comment on Lott tax remarks.

text.p: The White House on Wednesday declined comment on Republican Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott's statement that he would like to see a multi-year tax cut package worth more than $150 billion.

Lott, asked about a statement he made earlier on Wednesday that Republican legislative priorities for the year included a multi-year tax cut package worth $100 to $150 billion, told reporters: "I would like it to be more than that."
White House spokesman Mike McCurry declined comment on the matter, saying he would not discuss budgetary issues before the administration releases its fiscal 1998 budget next month.
